article_framing_rejections.headline: 17 arrested in drug trafficking investigation centered in Indiantown

lead_independence.headline: 17 arrested in drug trafficking investigation centered in Indiantown
lead_independence.lead: A drug investigation with links to Martin and St. Lucie counties and to Daytona Beach resulted in the arrests of 17 people with three more sought, Martin County Sheriff John Budensiek announced Aug. 14. Budensiek announced the results of the investigation, named Operation Beneath The Surface, at the sheriff's office with federal partners from the FDA, DEA and Homeland Security present. A total of more than four kilos of cocaine, two pounds of marijuana, three ounces of methamphetamine, and eight guns were seized during the investigation.
